title: Finishing high school and earning degrees at Pennsylvania
summary: After Pearl Harbor his choir members go into defense work, so he returns to school, earning bachelor's and master's degrees at the University of Pennsylvania.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: At the same time while I was finishing my high school. Cause see, I had to go back to high school.

Cause, see, I'm only in the second year. And by the time I'd finished that, I had my choir ready. So I wouldn't have got -- gone back to it no more. I would have kept on with the choir, but the Japanese got smart at Pearl Harbor, you know?

And all my boys went into defense work, you know? And those that wasn't drafted went into defense work. So there wasn't nothing for me to do but just quit and go back to school. And I went on the the University of Pennsylvania and got my Bachelors and then I got my Masters Degree. But the reason I did that was because my little girl was growing up now, and I wanted to go into one of the campuses and live on the
campus and raise my kid, see. I didn't want them to say that I was a piano plunker.
I got my Masters Degree, so I could be considered a professor, you see?
The name you didn't like. The term you didn't like, professor.
So you became a real professor.
Why, that was because the cruisers from the bawdy houses used to say, 'Come on, professor.' And kick out a rag.
